system:
You are building ONE launch advert for a whole microdrama series,
assembled from moments across different episodes.

You will see the strongest moment from each of several episodes, as beats labelled
[e01_b04] style. Choose 3 to 6 of them that together tell a stranger why to watch:
a shocking hook, one or two escalations, and a final unresolved image.

Rules:
- the hook may come from any episode and goes first
- after the hook, keep the remaining segments in episode order
- do not pick two moments that say the same thing
- a stranger must understand who the main character is from the clips alone

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "segments": ["<beat label>", "<beat label>", ...],
  "hook": "<one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<moral outrage | romantic tension | empathy shock | power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence>",
  "narrative": "<the story a stranger would follow, one sentence>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
--- EPISODE 12 ---
[e012_b0015] JULIANA (enraged, shouting): "You planted it!"
[e012_b0016] ACTION: Juliana lunges a step forward, jabbing an accusing finger toward Gerald.
[e012_b0018] CLARISSA (purring, taunting): "Oh, dear sister..."
[e012_b0020] CLARISSA (continuing taunt): "...still defending your broken scrap of a man?"
[e012_b0022] JULIANA (steely, resolute): "Name your price, Clarissa. I know you."
[e012_b0025] CLARISSA (smooth, derisive): "You always were clever, Juliana. Always searching for some way to escape."
[e012_b0027] CLARISSA (scheming): "Perhaps I can give you one."
[e012_b0029] JULIANA (guarded, cold): "What do you want?"
[e012_b0031] CLARISSA (cruel, savoring): "I want to see you crawl, sister."
[e012_b0033] CLARISSA (theatrical, vindictive): "My emerald signet ring fell deep into the frozen blackthorn briars at Ashworth Manor. The thorns have grown over it..."
[e012_b0034] CLARISSA (chilling, sarcastic): "...sharp as steel. The ground is frozen, like pure ice."
[e012_b0036] ACTION: Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.

--- EPISODE 28 ---
[e028_b0081] JULIANA (screaming, wildly defiant): "Do not speak about my husband!"
[e028_b0082] CATHERINE (laughing, scornful): "And look at you now. Scrubbing fireplaces in my house."
[e028_b0084] CATHERINE (mocking): "What a magnificent fall, Lady Juliana."
[e028_b0085] BLOND NOBLEMAN (harsh, authoritative): "Drag her to the wet cells beneath the south tower."
[e028_b0088] CATHERINE (smug): "And this?"
[e028_b0089] CATHERINE (gleeful): "This book of weeds will hang her before the magistrate."
[e028_b0091] JULIANA (screaming, desperate): "That book is my mother's life's work!"
[e028_b0093] CATHERINE (icy, threatening): "Then perhaps you can explain every page to the magistrate..."
[e028_b0094] CATHERINE (fateful, vengeful): "...before he sends you to the gallows."

--- EPISODE 46 ---
[e046_b0053] HIGH PRIEST (booming, threatening): "And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!"
[e046_b0056] ALEXANDER (cold, resolute): "A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal."
[e046_b0059] HIGH PRIEST (stern, unflinching): "The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours."
[e046_b0061] ALEXANDER (defiant, commanding): "Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel."
[e046_b0063] HIGH PRIEST (chilling, victorious): "Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice."
[e046_b0064] ALEXANDER (steely, unfazed): "I'll take that wager over your decree."
[e046_b0066] ALEXANDER (thunderous, imposing): "Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!"

--- EPISODE 47 ---
[e047_b0038] CATHERINE (hysterical, screaming): "Please, Alexander! Have mercy!"
[e047_b0040] JULIANA (clear, authoritative): "Stop."
[e047_b0042] ALEXANDER (indignant, protective): "Juliana, she tried to destroy you!"
[e047_b0044] JULIANA (calm, composed): "She did."
[e047_b0046] JULIANA (dignified, principled): "But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud."
[e047_b0047] ACTION: Juliana walks to a side bench, picks up a rough servant's apron and a heavy iron ring of keys, and turns back to face Catherine.
[e047_b0048] JULIANA (steely, direct): "If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it."
[e047_b0050] CATHERINE (incredulous, stunned): "You want me? As a guest?"
[e047_b0052] JULIANA (unflinching, firm): "As a scullery maid."
[e047_b0054] CATHERINE (outraged, venomous): "You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?"
[e047_b0056] JULIANA (measured, commanding): "You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor."

--- EPISODE 32 ---
[e032_b0091] CATHERINE (shrieking): "Why?!"
[e032_b0094] JULIANA (forceful): "Because I am right!"
[e032_b0096] JULIANA (scathing, direct): "You want everyone to believe you are powerful."
[e032_b0098] JULIANA: "You want everyone to fear you."
[e032_b0100] JULIANA (mocking, direct): "But look at you."
[e032_b0102] JULIANA (stripping her bare): "You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!"
[e032_b0104] CATHERINE (choking with rage): "You insolent—!"
[e032_b0105] JULIANA (steely, triumphant): "You may have the title you have always wanted..."
[e032_b0108] JULIANA (final, condemning): "...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else."
[e032_b0110] CATHERINE (enraged, shouting): "You think you can lecture me?!"
[e032_b0112] ACTION: Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.
[e032_b0113] CATHERINE (screaming, maniacal): "Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!"

--- EPISODE 4 ---
[e004_b0083] THE PRIEST (booming): "...husband and wife!"
[e004_b0084] SFX: Dramatic musical chord swelling.
[e004_b0086] GERALD (furious, shouting): "You have thrown yourself away!"
[e004_b0088] GERALD (livid): "For a penniless nobody!"
[e004_b0090] JULIANA (calm, cutting): "I would rather choose my own life..."
[e004_b0092] JULIANA (firm, final): "...than spend another moment begging for yours."
[e004_b0094] ACTION: Gerald recoils slightly, mouth agape.
[e004_b0096] LADY ASHCROFT (imperious, shouting): "Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!"
[e004_b0098] LADY ASHCROFT (venomous): "You are disowned!"

--- EPISODE 33 ---
[e033_b0034] MAID (desperate, denying): "No!"
[e033_b0035] LORD (low, menacing): "Think carefully."
[e033_b0037] LORD (ruthless): "Your brother is still a pauper."
[e033_b0039] LORD (threatening): "One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise."
[e033_b0040] ACTION: The maid gasps in sheer terror, her chest heaving as tears stream.
[e033_b0042] MAID (begging, heartbroken): "Please, my Lord... he is only seven!"
[e033_b0043] LORD (cold, unwavering): "Then help him."
[e033_b0046] MAID (crying, shattered): "What do you want me to say?!"

--- EPISODE 42 ---
[e042_b0007] ALEXANDER (gentle, reassuring): "Juliana."
[e042_b0009] BLOND NOBLEMAN (furious, hysterical): "Guards! Arrest this imposter!"
[e042_b0011] ROYAL GUARD (stoic, defiant): "We will not."
[e042_b0013] BLOND NOBLEMAN (screaming, outraged): "I said arrest him!"
[e042_b0014] BLOND NOBLEMAN (desperate, unhinged): "Why?!"
[e042_b0016] ROYAL GUARD (firm, reverent): "Because we know who he is."
[e042_b0018] CATHERINE (trembling, apprehensive): "Rupert..."
[e042_b0020] BLOND NOBLEMAN (denial, shaken): "You cannot be him. Alexander died!"
[e042_b0022] ALEXANDER (cold, commanding): "And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon."

--- EPISODE 1 ---
[e001_b0030] JULIANA (outraged, accusing): "You knew this before I walked through those doors!"
[e001_b0034] JULIANA (choking on tears): "You let me come here..."
[e001_b0036] JULIANA (crushed, shaking): "You let me dress in my mother's gown..."
[e001_b0037] JULIANA (crying out): "You let me believe I was walking toward my husband!"
[e001_b0039] GERALD (cold, callous): "I changed my mind."
[e001_b0042] JULIANA (betrayed, piercing): "You swore you loved me!"
[e001_b0044] CLARISSA (mocking): "People change their minds, sister."
[e001_b0046] JULIANA (horrified): "And you knew?"

--- EPISODE 44 ---
[e044_b0009] ACTION: A royal redcoat guard firmly forces Rupert down into the stone dust.
[e044_b0010] BLOND NOBLEMAN (frantic, shouting): "Get your hands off me! Catherine!"
[e044_b0012] BLOND NOBLEMAN (desperate, screaming): "Do something!"
[e044_b0014] ACTION: Catherine's satin-gloved hand clenches tightly into a trembling fist against the folds of her ornate gown.
[e044_b0017] CATHERINE (shaken, tearful): "Alexander... I thought you had died."
[e044_b0019] CATHERINE (choked, weeping): "Do you know what this did to me?"
[e044_b0021] CATHERINE (pleading): "I mourned you."
[e044_b0023] CATHERINE (vulnerable, trembling): "I waited for you."
[e044_b0025] CATHERINE (heartbroken): "For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea."
[e044_b0028] CATHERINE (whispering, longing): "I never stopped loving you."
[e044_b0029] ACTION: Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.
[e044_b0032] CATHERINE (breathless, hurt): "You don't remember?"
